items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

ctx.x: Your wife was there, my wife was there, Basie’s wife was there. Woody and Lionel was there. The band was —
Oh, yeah, friends of Ellington. Yeah.

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: The whole Woody Herman‟s band played there.

We would line up along that bar like it was a prisoner‟s… and played. It was quite interesting. But I will tell you the contact was wonderful. I got a lot of gigs, a lot of record dates out of that. Contractors would come by there and…
